name: comp-301
title: Cookie Consent Banner
blurb: Full-width cookie consent banner with message and accept/decline buttons.
description: Full-width cookie consent banner with message text and two action buttons, responsive layout (stacked on mobile, inline on desktop).
use_when: You need a persistent, full-width cookie consent notice that matches page layout.
avoid_when: For modal-style consents; use a card or modal component instead.
a11y: No aria attributes required; buttons are keyboard accessible. No animation.
